The “Custom Characters” segment is visually distinct with a red coloration, contrasting with the green of “Real Characters” and the blue of “Virtual Characters.” The outer segments are colored light blue and are labeled with black text. The chart does not include a legend or percentage indicators within the segments, and no segments are visually emphasized through expansion, displacement, or bolding. The outer segments are arranged in a circular fashion around the central “Virtual Characters” segment, appearing to be ordered by size in descending order from left to right.
model_annotations.English: This circular chart visually compares two main categories—“Virtual Characters” and “Real Characters”—with “Virtual Characters” occupying the central, largest blue area and “Real Characters” forming a smaller green segment adjacent to it. The “Virtual Characters” category is further subdivided into six distinct slices labeled “Comic Characters,” “Movie Characters,” “Teleplay Characters,” “Novel Characters,” “Game Characters,” and “Custom Characters,” each represented by a light blue segment radiating outward from the center. The “Real Characters” category is subdivided into seven smaller green slices labeled “Scientists,” “Artists,” “Athletes,” “Writers,” “Musicians,” “Actors,” and “Influencers.” The chart includes a legend that distinguishes the blue and green segments as “Virtual Characters” and “Real Characters,” respectively, and the labels for each slice are positioned around the perimeter. No percentage values are displayed within the slices, and no segments are visually emphasized through explosion or bolding; however, the slices appear to be arranged in descending order of size within each category, with “Virtual Characters” being significantly larger than “Real Characters.”
model_annotations.German: Das Diagramm zeigt eine zweistufige Aufteilung von Charakteren, wobei der äußere Ring „Virtual Characters“ (virtuelle Charaktere) in sechs Segmente unterteilt ist – „Comic Characters“ (hellblau), „Movie Characters“ (hellblau), „Teleplay Characters“ (hellblau), „Novel Characters“ (hellblau), „Game Characters“ (hellblau) und „Custom Characters“ (rosa) – und der innere Ring „Real Characters“ (reale Charaktere) in sieben Segmente – „Scientists“ (grün), „Artists“ (grün), „Athletes“ (grün), „Writers“ (grün), „Musicians“ (grün), „Actors“ (grün) und „Influencers“ (grün). Der äußere Ring „Virtual Characters“ nimmt den größten Anteil ein und ist in sechs gleichmäßig verteilte Segmente unterteilt, während der innere Ring „Real Characters“ in sieben Segmente unterteilt ist, die visuell kleiner erscheinen und in einer absteigenden Reihenfolge angeordnet sind. Die Segmente sind durch Farben unterschieden, wobei „Virtual Characters“ hellblau und „Real Characters“ grün dargestellt sind, und „Custom Characters“ als einziger Segment im äußeren Ring rosa hervorgehoben ist. Es gibt keine Prozentangaben innerhalb der Segmente, aber die Größe der Segmente deutet auf eine relative Verteilung hin.
